name: Pre-gait vacuum

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Planck scale cutoff and the cosmological constant limit

VINIT.justification: The state before any field distinction or naming of particles occurs.

TANCH.justification: The global boundary that contains the total energy density of the vacuum.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation from ground state to an energized state.

AREV.justification: The descent from an excited state back toward the ground state.

CLINK.justification: The sequential composition of multiple quantum fields into a single vacuum state.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential identity of the field in its ground state.

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of the vacuum unit into virtual particle and anti-particle pairs.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the virtual pair back into the original vacuum unit.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative phase alignment of vacuum fluctuations.

EVALF.justification: The negative phase cancellation of vacuum fluctuations.

ENGAGR.justification: The B-state where the vacuum is simultaneously empty and full of potential energy.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of a measurement event in the vacuum history.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized pre-field state before the first fluctuation
phase_3.true_description: Stable field excitation or constructive presence
phase_3.both_description: The B-state vacuum: both nothing and everything simultaneously

steps.domain_action: The pre-geometric void exists before field definition
The vacuum recognizes itself as a self-referential ground state
The vacuum enters the B-state, holding both empty and full potential
The ground state differentiates into virtual particle-antiparticle pairs
Constructive interference stabilizes the T-branch of the fluctuation
The fluctuation propagates forward in time as a virtual excitation
The anti-particle branch provides the contravariant descent
Destructive interference anchors the F-branch of the fluctuation
The virtual pairs annihilate, reconstituting the original vacuum unit
The cycle chains into the next temporal slice of the field
The zero-point energy summation is recorded as a permanent physical constant
The terminal anchor closes the system at the cosmological boundary

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is adiabatic and information-preserving through Frobenius closure
